summary: st-test's pool-tree tickets rank by the cargo shim's caller (ST_AGENT, else CARGO_PRIORITY_CALLER), a waiting run reads the pool size on every pass so a tree added when the host's heavy slots grow is taken at once, and a ticket whose pid was reused by a younger process is dropped

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: What is signed is unchanged; only which waiting run gets the next pool tree.

compatibility.detail: A run with ST_AGENT set ranks as before; one with only CARGO_PRIORITY_CALLER now ranks as the shim ranks it instead of at 50.
